2003 NASDAQ-100 Open – Women's Doubles | Lisa Raymond and Rennae Stubbs were the defending champions, but competed this year with different partners. While Bovina did not compete this year, Stubbs pertnered with Cara Black and successfully defended her title, defeating Elena Likhovtseva and Magdalena Maleeva 6–0, 6–1 in the final.  It was the 2nd title in the year for the pair, and the 14th title for Black and 44th title for Stubbs, in their respective careers.

Despite posting doubles victories over top professionals such as Betty Stöve, Hana Mandlíková and Renáta Tomanová, Zaitseva did not compete at any point on the women's professional tennis circuit or at any of the Grand Slams and thus never attained a world ranking.
